title: Book of Babel
description:
You'll find many a guide book in your adventures. Even with quests, sometimes you want a bit of more traditional reading. But carrying all those books around can be a hassle. Luckily for you, I, Professor Larch, know of a quite... §6§oEccentric Tome§r.
§6§oYou can combine this tome with any of your guide books in a crafting grid, and it will be added to the tome's chapters.§r From there, you simply right click with the tome to select the book you'd like to read. Hitting the air with the book in hand will return it to the tome.§r
